request:
Condense the following paragraph to two sentences, keeping every number.

The build pipeline was moved from the shared runners to a dedicated machine with a local cache in March. Before the move a full build took twelve minutes on average and failed about once a day for reasons unrelated to the code, usually a timeout fetching dependencies. Since the move the average is four minutes, the dependency timeouts are gone, and the two remaining intermittent failures were traced to a flaky integration test that has since been fixed.

Write release notes for version 2.1, for users, from this changelog. Group them under Added, Changed and Removed, one short line each.

- feat: dark mode, follows the system setting
- feat: keyboard shortcuts for the ten most used actions (see Help > Shortcuts)
- fix: exporting a project with more than 500 items crashed
- fix: the search box lost focus after each keystroke on Firefox
- chore: the legacy CSV importer, deprecated in 1.8, is removed
- chore: bump dependencies

Explain what this function does to someone who has written a little Python but no Elixir, in at most 80 words.

```elixir
def mean([]), do: raise ArgumentError, "empty list"
def mean(numbers), do: Enum.sum(numbers) / length(numbers)
```

Rewrite this email so that it is polite and clear, still asks for the quarterly report by Friday, and stays under 60 words.

Where is the report. I asked last week. Need it Friday or the board pack is late. Send it.

Turn these meeting notes into a list of action items, each with its owner and, where given, its date.

Notes: Ana will book the venue once Luis confirms the budget (Luis to review the budget by Tuesday). Mei collects talk proposals; deadline for proposals is the 20th. Luis sends the agenda after the venue is booked. Everyone reviews the code of conduct draft before the next meeting.

Give this text a one-line title of at most eight words.

We planned the database migration for one quarter. It took two. The delay had three causes: the schema had undocumented constraints that only showed up under production data, the team lost two members mid-way, and the rollback plan had never been rehearsed, so every step was taken more slowly than it needed to be.

Translate this paragraph into Spanish, keeping the numbers and the tone.

The build pipeline moved to a dedicated machine in March. A full build used to take twelve minutes; now it takes four. The dependency timeouts that failed about one build a day are gone.

Write a git commit message for this change: the client's function `fetch_all/1` is renamed to `list/1`, its three callers are updated, and the old name is kept as a deprecated alias for one release. First line imperative and under 72 characters, then a blank line and the reasons.

List exactly three questions a reviewer should ask about this plan, each one sentence.

Plan: migrate the user table to a new schema over a weekend by copying rows in batches of 10,000 while the application keeps writing to the old table, then switch the application to the new table and drop the old one on Monday.

Turn these bullet points into one paragraph of plain prose, keeping every fact.

- Prices rose 4% in the quarter
- Demand held steady
- Margins narrowed because costs rose faster than prices
- The forecast for next year is flat

Explain this error message to a user who is not a programmer, in two sentences, and say what they can try.

Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432

Make this announcement shorter, at most 25 words, without losing the date, the time or the place.

We are very pleased to announce that the annual general meeting of the association will take place this year on the 12th of May at seven o'clock in the evening in the main hall of the town hall, and we warmly invite all members to attend.
